title: Integral localization commutes with bounded qcqs pushforward
statement: For the coefficient inclusion of [def-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-coefficients], any qcqs map f:X→Y of schemes, and any bounded constructible integral complex K on X, the specified component derivedPushHom(a,f).app K is an isomorphism. Pushforward is ordinary and uncompleted, and no proper base change assertion is assumed.

proof.text: The compact-test localization and exact inverse image identify scalar extension with the ℓ-localization telescope. Exactness allows termwise calculation on a good truncation of a representative of K. The sequential diagram has one uniform lower cohomological bound.

Apply condensed_qcqs_pushforward_continuity degree by degree. Its canonical cohomology map is the restriction of derivedPushHom: on each localization leg the adjoint definition is the same unit map followed by division by ℓⁿ. Homology detects isomorphisms, and exact faithful restriction reflects them.

proof_origin.note: A2: the Lean proof and remaining named obligations follow these steps, using the actual integral coefficient functor. No proper base change assumption is used.

theorem integralScalarPushHom_isIso {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f] (K : integralConstructible ℓ E X) :
    IsIso ((derivedPushHom (integralScalarMap ℓ E) f).app K.obj)
